data.name: Welcome_Subject
data.value: Welcome to Marechai — your seat at the table of computing history

data.name: Welcome_Title
data.value: Welcome to Marechai!

data.name: Welcome_Lead
data.value: We're thrilled you've joined us, {0}.

data.name: Welcome_Intro
data.value: Marechai is a community-curated archive of the machines, software, books and magazines that shaped how we compute today — and you're now part of the team keeping that memory alive.

data.name: Welcome_ProfileBullet
data.value: Make the place yours. Head to your profile, add a bio, pick an avatar — let other collectors and historians know who you are.

data.name: Welcome_CollectionBullet
data.value: Build your collection. Browse the computers, consoles and smartphones you've owned (or still treasure) and add them to your shelf for everyone to see.

data.name: Welcome_SoftwareBullet
data.value: Rediscover old friends. Our software catalogue holds thousands of titles — there's a good chance the games, applications and operating systems you remember are waiting there.

data.name: Welcome_BooksBullet
data.value: Don't forget the paper. Books and magazines that taught a generation to code are in here too. Search for the ones you read; if they're missing, you can help us add them.

data.name: Welcome_Closing
data.value: Marechai is a labour of love built by people like you. Whatever drew you here — nostalgia, research, preservation — we're glad you came, and we hope you'll feel at home.

data.name: Welcome_Signoff
data.value: Welcome aboard,

data.name: Welcome_Footer
data.value: — The Marechai team
